english: A continuous frequency distribution has the following classes and frequencies.

Let $k$ be a real number with $k<10$. The variance of the five observations $10,20,30,40,k$ is five times the variance of the above distribution, computed with the class marks. Then the value of $k$ is ______.
hindi: एक सतत बारंबारता बंटन के वर्ग तथा बारंबारताएँ निम्न हैं।
माना $k$ एक वास्तविक संख्या है जहाँ $k<10$ है। पाँच प्रेक्षणों $10,20,30,40,k$ का प्रसरण, वर्ग चिह्नों से परिकलित उपरोक्त बंटन के प्रसरण का पाँच गुना है। तब $k$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: For the distribution, the class marks are $5,15,25,35,45$. With $u=\dfrac{m-25}{10}$: $u=-2,-1,0,1,2$, frequencies $1,4,6,4,1$, $N=16$.
originality_note: New: an ungrouped set with one free observation is tied to a grouped distribution through a variance ratio; the quadratic has two roots symmetric about the mean of the other four, and an order condition picks the negative one (way 3: object fixed by two conditions). Closest known: 'find the missing observation given the variance'. Different because: the target variance comes from a separate grouped table and the root is selected by a side condition.
stem_review: Read as a student: every observation, class, symbol and condition is introduced before use, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (exact fractions / sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Added k < 10 to make the answer unique (the other root is 75). Changed: added the condition.
key_step: Step deviations for the grouped variance, then a quadratic for k with the root chosen by k < 10.
justification: Two routine variance computations and a quadratic; no insight. Comparable to 2026-P2-Q12 (L2).

concept_use.Standard deviation and variance of a con: Step-deviation variance of the grouped table, 100.
